title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E5 — Cook's Tour
DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E9 — Showdown!
A gang of toughs jeopardizes the team's reputation by posing as the four and terrorizing rodeo performers and spectators.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E10 — Sheriffs of Rivertown
A U.S. oil company wants order restored in a makeshift community housing workers for a South American electrical-power plant.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E11 — The Bells of St. Mary's
An all-girl band from Face's old orphanage hires the team to go after a corrupt record-company executive (Robert Desiderio).

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E12 — Hot Styles
The team infiltrates the fashion world to rescue Face's girlfriend (Markie Post) from her kidnapper (Richard Lynch).

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E13 — Breakout!
Hannibal devises an elaborate escape plan after B.A. and Murdock are mistaken for accomplices in a robbery and sentenced to work on a chain gang.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E14 — Cup A'Joe
B.A. and Murdock help a diner owner and his daughter fight a corrupt tycoon who wants their land for an off-ramp.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E15 — The Big Squeeze
The team works from a pub to stop a loan shark (Joseph Sirola) from terrorizing small businesses; guest Wings Hauser.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E16 — Champ!
To stop a mobster's takeover of local boxing events, Hannibal sets up a syndicate with B.A. fighting as Volcano Johnson.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E17 — Skins
Infatuated B.A. volunteers the team to help a Kenyan game warden (Daphne Maxwell) find the poachers who killed her brother.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E18 — Road Games
As payment for a debt, the mob demands a reformed gambler (Jason Evers) sign over a foster home he and his daughter run.
